fichas.title: Layout and dimensioning of architectural drawings
fichas.summary: Guidance for organizing construction drawings and scale details, preparing title blocks and permit drawings, indicating north, choosing scales, dimensioning plans and sections, and marking levels, sections, room numbers, and room areas. The illustrated examples show elevations, floor and site plans, an angled floor plan, and height markings.
uses: Prepare construction drawings and scale details
Identify drawing type, building category, and scale
Indicate compass direction, levels, sections, and room information
